provenance: IMPORTED from Sun-Yang-Li, ePrint 2025/1493 Table 4 (89 g-XOR AES MixColumns). Not our result. Input bits relabeled to this repo's convention; gate order as in the paper.
outputConvention: output j (j in 0..31) is MixColumns output bit j; bit j = bit (j mod 8) of state byte (j div 8), least-significant-bit-first within each byte, the same convention as ../circuits/ and verify_circuit.py. It is produced at signal index outputSignals[j]: signals 0..31 are the 32 input bits and gate k produces signal 32+k. Added 2026-07-29 for explicitness; derived from the gate list, which is unchanged.
